title: NBA: Cavs edge Timberwolves in OT despite superb Edwards
summary: The Cleveland Cavaliers ended the Minnesota Timberwolves' perfect start to the NBA season, winning 127-125 in an overtime thriller despite 47 points from Anthony Edwards.
